title: Mriia: apps for your phone
description: Your songs, the weather and the air in the morning, live TV from around the world at night. Light apps that install on your phone in one tap.
shareTitle: Mriia: every little thing is superintelligent
shareDescription: The weather at dawn, tarot by day, live TV from around the world at night. Light apps for your phone.
ogAlt: Mriia: app screens on a phone
lede: Your songs in one player. The weather while the kettle boils. Live TV from the other side of the world. Light apps that install on your phone in one tap.
heroBackAlt: The Mriia catalog on a phone
railTitle: From the first coffee to the last track
installText: Tap “Install” and it sits on your home screen next to your favourites. No store, no waiting.
langText: English and Ukrainian, from the first screen to the last button. Switch any time in your profile.
m_weather: Still in bed, and you already know if it is a hat day.
m_air: Before your run, see what the city is breathing today.
m_tarot: One card a day, and a quiet minute to think about yours.
m_fonoteka: Your songs on one shelf, each with a shape of its own.
m_muzak: Everything you liked on YouTube, playing here in your own player.
m_iptv: Evening, the couch, and live TV from any country.
m_remix: Your favourite track, slowed down with an echo. Just right at 1 a.m.
